products.description: EP&N Node runs a gram on your machine. It joins the EP&N network, does work for other people when your machine is free, meters every unit of it, and shows what it earned. Using your own machine costs you nothing; you are paid only when others use it.
products.summary: Run a gram: share your machine's compute on the EP&N network and see what it earns.

products.description: Ethos Studio makes eApps out of contracts: describe the app to Evo, see it run, and ship it to the same stores and devices as every other Ethos app, without writing code.
products.summary: Build eApps from contracts, with Evo, without writing code.

products.description: A browser that keeps what you do on your own side: one search across several engines, trackers blocked before they load, your spaces and your neighbourhood (Mohalla Map, by pincode), and every Ethos eApp in one place. GramX, the live world, opens from the same app.
products.summary: The EVO browser, and GramX: the live world. Every Ethos eApp in one app.
